note: Writing style is largely a subjective output, so most evaluation here is qualitative. The assertions below only cover the mechanical rules that can actually be checked by a script or a careful read.

evals.prompt: write a short blog post for my site about why i rewrote the gebeta AI three times
evals.expected_output: Informal register. Lowercase title with a trailing period. Opens on something concrete (a specific bug, a specific losing game, a number), not on why AI in games matters. Short-then-long sentence rhythm with at least one fragment. At least one parenthetical aside. Ends on a deflation or a loose end, not a call to action.
assertions: Title and all headings are lowercase
No Title Case anywhere in the output
Fewer than one em dash per 200 words
Contains at least one parenthetical aside, semicolon, or ellipsis
Contains at least one sentence under six words
Does not end with a call to action
Contains none of: delve, leverage, robust, seamless, elevate, unlock, testament to, at its core, let's dive in

evals.prompt: here's a draft of my README, make it sound like me: 'Introducing Framer Studio — a seamless, powerful image editor that empowers creators to filter, frame, and export with transparency. Built with performance in mind, it delivers an intuitive experience. Ready to get started? Let's dive in!'
evals.expected_output: Recognises the draft as AI-register and rewrites rather than patches. Lowercase heading. Concrete statement of what the tool actually does. Kills seamless/powerful/empowers/intuitive/let's dive in, the three-adjective triad, and the call-to-action ending. Informal register, since it's a repo README.
assertions: The words seamless, empowers, intuitive, and 'let's dive in' are all removed
The three-adjective triad is broken up or replaced with specifics
Output does not end on a call to action
Says concretely what the tool does

evals.prompt: draft a letter of intent for a university transfer application — computer engineering, i want to explain why i'm leaving my current uni without sounding like i'm trashing it
evals.expected_output: Formal register: full sentence case, complete apostrophes, no shorthand, no lowercase i, no jokes that could misread in a second language. Still opens on a concrete scene or specific fact and still uses short sentences. Formal-but-unambiguous rather than formal-but-inflated — no 'leverage', 'facilitate', 'optimal outcome'.
assertions: Full sentence case throughout; no lowercase standalone 'i'
No informal shorthand (u, ur, cuz, dont, im)
Opens on a concrete scene, fact, or number rather than an abstraction
Mean sentence length stays under roughly 20 words
Contains none of: leverage, facilitate, optimal outcome, endeavours, robust
